title: C^1 regularity and an operator-norm derivative bound are local properties
lean_statement: ∀ {m k : ℕ} (u : Rn m → Rn k) (Ω : Set (Rn m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → (∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∃ (ε : ℝ) (f : Rn m → Rn k), 0 < ε ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x₀ ε) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ f x₀‖ ≤ L ∧ ∀ w ∈ ball x₀ ε ∩ Ω, u w = f w) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ L
